name: Recursive Expansion Variant 4
task:
Please complete the following four-stage sequence analysis task.

=== Stage 1: Pattern Identification ===
A chain letter: each person sends to 3 new people. Start with 1 person. Track total recipients.

=== Stage 2: Term Generation ===
Generate the first 8 terms using the pattern.

=== Stage 3: Formula Derivation ===
Try to derive a closed-form expression.

=== Stage 4: Prediction ===
Predict term 20 and verify.
